name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created example.py with the quickstart code, and ran it. The API call succeeded and generated a valid 45KB MP3 audio file (output.mp3) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The file is confirmed to be a proper MPEG ADTS layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural — exactly matching the requested output_format.
deviations: The quickstart instructs to use `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output device, I adapted the code to save the audio stream to a file (output.mp3) instead. This is a necessary environment adaptation that does not affect the core promised outcome (generating an audio file from text).

configured.evidence: python example.py ... exit=0 ... Audio file generated: output.mp3 (API call succeeded, proving credentials were present)

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
